description: Alternative Fuel Stations in U.S. is a dataset listed in Fulton County open data portal (sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Fulton County. This dataset contains information on alternative fuel stations in the U.S. as compiled and maintained by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL). Details on individual stations include type of fuel (electric, natural gas, hydrogen, etc.), address, date opened, access (public/private) and cost. Coverage: Fulton County, Georgia. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are energy, station, fuel, renewable, alternative. The table has 28 columns. Attribution on the portal: National Renewable Energy Laboratory. The portal shows 2021-12-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-sharefulton-fultoncountyga-gov-portal.
